hazards.evidence: Wooden handrail is present only on the right side of the staircase; no handrail on the left side.
Objects on the steps: a stack of folded clothes/towels on a mid stair and footwear on a lower step.
Stairway is dim and shadowy; treads are poorly illuminated despite a small wall light.
Carpeted steps have no contrasting nosing and the tread/riser edges visually blend together, making step edges hard to distinguish.
